about:
# Wildly Forever

**Wildly** is a lightweight buff manager for druids, inspired by **PallyPower**. It tracks
*Mark of the Wild* (and *Gift of the Wild*) and *Thorns* across your party or raid and lets you
rebuff with a single click.

This is the **World of Warcraft: Forever** edition (client 1.60.1, Interface `16001`).

> **[Buffy](https://github.com/Spotnick2/Buffy) is the new consolidated version.** It combines
> Magely, Priestly and Wildly in one addon on the same engine, and picks Mage, Priest or Druid
> buffs for the character you log in. It starts with fresh settings rather than importing
> Wildly's, so disable Wildly while you use it, or you get two buff windows.

![Wildly buff window in a group](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Spotnick2/Wildly/main/docs/screenshots/wildly-screen1.png)

*Example from an earlier build; the current window has additional controls.*

> **Playing TBC Classic Anniversary?** Install **v0.1.1**, the last release for that client. It
> stays available on CurseForge for the Anniversary game version. The Anniversary line is no longer
> being developed.

Wildly shares its engine and window with **Priestly** through the
[LibGroupBuffs](https://github.com/Spotnick2/LibGroupBuffs) library, so a fix to one reaches both.

---

## Features

* **One row per group, per buff**, colour-coded by how many people are missing it, with the lowest
  remaining timer on the bar.
* **One-click buffing.** Left-click casts Gift of the Wild on the group, right-click buffs the first
  person missing it. No targeting.
* **Works before you have Gift of the Wild.** While you only know Mark of the Wild, left-click
  simply buffs whoever needs it. Nothing is wired to a spell you do not have.
* **Thorns where it belongs.** Choose who the Thorns row covers: the group's tanks (or you, if it
  has none), tanks only, yourself, everyone, or nobody. Everyone includes pets when
  **Track pets** is enabled; self and tank modes cover players only.
* **Per-member popover.** Mouse over a row for the full list with range indicators and per-person
  click casting.
* **Group-aware.** It follows party and raid changes, subgroups, and pets.
* **Reagent tracking.** The Wild Berries or Wild Thornroot count, for the Gift of the Wild rank you
  know.
* **Window controls.** Minimize without closing, lock its position, adjust opacity and choose
  which side the member popover opens on.

---

## Usage

Use the header **-** to minimize to the title bar and **+** to restore. Requests in
combat wait until combat ends. Minimized state lasts for this session; `/reload`
or logging in expands the window again. **X** closes the window.

In the popover, **? beside the class icon** means spell range is unknown.
**? instead of a timer** means the buff cannot be read and there is no cached reading.

```
/wildly          toggle the window
/wildly show     force open
/wildly hide     close
/wildly config   open the options panel
/wildly reset    reset the window position
/wildly pos      why the window is where it is
/wildly help     full command and click reference, then the spell names Wildly reads
```

The window opens on its own when you join a group. Wildly does nothing on other classes.
Settings and window position persist between sessions.

**Row colours:** green = everyone has it · yellow = some missing · red = nobody has it ·
grey `?` = buff state cannot be read right now (the client hides aura data during combat, so
Wildly keeps counting down from the last reading instead of guessing).

---

## Installation

### CurseForge (recommended)

Install through the CurseForge app and enable it in game.

### GitHub and Wago

Download from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Spotnick2/Wildly/releases/latest)
or [Wago Addons](https://addons.wago.io/addons/wildly). Both include the required libraries.
The GitHub release includes `release.json` for compatible addon managers.

### Manual

Download the release zip and extract it so the folder lands at:

```
World of Warcraft/_forever_/Interface/AddOns/Wildly/
```

---

## Good to know

**Pet eligibility:** hunter and warlock pets are excluded from Mark of the Wild
tracking and targeting. Thorns includes tracked pets in Everyone mode.

Wildly uses single-target Mark of the Wild until you learn Gift of the Wild. It learns buff
durations from live auras and relearns them when the client build changes. In the default Thorns
mode, if no group member has a tank role or raid main-tank assignment, Wildly tracks Thorns on you.

The window's text uses a font for your client's language, so names on a Korean or Chinese client
show as text. A Korean or Chinese name on an English client still shows as boxes, because the
English client has no font for it.

Forever can hide aura data during combat. Wildly uses its last observation and shows `?` if no
reliable reading is available. Window movement, closing and minimize/restore requests made during
combat take effect after combat ends.

If the game refuses Mark of the Wild or Thorns with "A more powerful spell is already active" out
of combat, because something stronger is already on that member, and the refused cast was the rank
the row casts (your highest; a macro's lower rank doesn't count), the row's single-target click
skips them for up to 30 seconds: for Mark, both clicks until you learn Gift of the Wild, then the
right click. Entering combat, or a buff being removed or updated on them, can end it sooner. Wildly
can't tell in advance whose buff is stronger, so the first cast on that member still fails, and
when everyone left has been refused the click casts nothing. It applies to players only: a refusal
on a pet isn't remembered. You can still pick them yourself from the popover.

---

## Feedback

Open an [issue on GitHub](https://github.com/Spotnick2/Wildly/issues) or leave a comment on
CurseForge. Include whether the problem happened in combat, and the lines `/wildly help` ends
with: your locale, game build, Wildly and library versions, and the spell names Wildly reads, with
any it could not read flagged. Typing
`/console scriptErrors 1` in game shows Lua errors that the client otherwise hides.

releases.name: Wildly Forever 1.1.2
releases.notes:
### Fixed
- When the game refuses Mark of the Wild or Thorns with "A more powerful spell is already
  active" out of combat, because something stronger is already on that member, the row's
  single-target click now skips them instead of trying them again. For Mark that's both clicks
  until you know Gift of the Wild, then the right click (the Gift click is unchanged); Thorns has
  only the single-target form. The refused cast teaches this whether it came from the window, an
  action bar or a macro, as long as it was the rank the row casts (your highest); a macro casting
  a lower rank that gets refused doesn't. The skip lasts up to 30 seconds; entering combat, or a
  buff being removed or updated on them, can end it sooner. If everyone left has been refused, the
  click casts nothing. You can still pick a skipped member yourself from the popover. It applies
  to players only: a refusal on a pet (Thorns in *Everyone* mode with pets tracked) isn't
  remembered, because a pet's name doesn't identify it. This has passed offline tests and was
  checked in game with Buffy's Fortitude on the same library; it hasn't been checked in game for
  Mark of the Wild or Thorns yet.

### Changed
- Updated the embedded LibGroupBuffs to r39 (was r36), which adds this refusal memory (#97).
  LibGlass is still r13.

releases.name: Wildly Forever 1.1.1
releases.notes:
### Changed
- **Checked on game build 1.60.1.70959**, the current WoW: Forever client. Nothing Wildly relies on
  changed in this build, so there is nothing to do after updating.
- The buff window's text now uses a font for your client's language. On a Korean or Chinese
  client, names that used to show as empty boxes now show as text. English and other clients look
  the same as before. A Korean or Chinese name on an English client still shows boxes: the English
  client has no font for it.
- Updated the embedded libraries to LibGlass r13 and LibGroupBuffs r36.

releases.name: Wildly 1.1.0
releases.notes:
### Added
- `/wildly help` now ends with a spell report: your locale, game build, Wildly and library
  versions, and the name of every spell Wildly matches buffs against, as your client gave it.
  A name Wildly could not read from the client is flagged and counted, and so is a Gift of the
  Wild rank it could not read. Please include these lines when reporting a problem, especially on
  a non-English client.

### Changed
- Updated the embedded LibGroupBuffs library to r34. LibGlass stays at r11.

releases.name: Wildly 1.0.6
releases.notes:
### Added
- Releases are also available on GitHub (with addon-manager metadata) and Wago Addons.
- Header controls to minimize the window and restore it without closing it.
  Requests in combat apply when combat ends. Minimized state is session-only.

### Changed
- The buff window and popup now sit below normal UI panels, including bags.
- Updated the embedded libraries to LibGroupBuffs r31 and LibGlass r11.

### Fixed
- Help distinguishes unknown spell range (`?` beside the class icon) from unreadable
  buff state (`?` instead of a timer).
- Hunter and Warlock pets no longer count as missing Mark of the Wild or appear
  as targets for that buff. Other pet types retain their existing eligibility.
- Thorns in Everyone mode includes pets when Track pets is enabled. Self and tank modes are unchanged.
